NoArchive Test Page

This page has a <meta name="robots" content="noarchive"> tag.

When you select text on this page and use "Explain with AI", the extension should detect the noarchive signal and include signals.noarchive: true in the payload sent to Lambda.

Test Words

Select one of these words to test:

  • Etymology - The study of word origins
  • Serendipity - Finding something good without looking for it
  • Ephemeral - Lasting for a very short time

Expected Behavior

  1. Extension detects noarchive meta tag
  2. Payload includes signals: { noarchive: true }
  3. Lambda generates etymology (user sees result)
  4. Lambda does NOT call save_state()
  5. No record in DynamoDB

Verification

Check CloudWatch logs for: NOARCHIVE: Skipping persistence for thread_id=...
